name: LAURA — LOA Submission Workflow

nodes.name: LOA Submitted (webhook)
nodes.notes: Triggered when a LOA is submitted from the frontend. Backend calls this webhook.

nodes.name: PPT required?
nodes.notes: LOAs over €50k require a PPT slide. Routes accordingly.

nodes.name: Validate schema (backend)
nodes.notes: Calls backend to run all validation rules: mandatory fields, math check, KPI check, photo rule.

nodes.name: Notify global brand teams
nodes.notes: Sends Teams message to relevant brand team channel. 5-day review window starts now.

nodes.name: Wait 5 days (brand window)
nodes.notes: EL requirement: global brands have exactly 5 working days to comment.

nodes.name: Move to CMO review
nodes.notes: Brand window closed. LOA moves to CMO/CFO review stage.
